# Values you can put in each notice

<!-- generated by tools/variables.mjs from variables.json: do not edit -->

Every value below was printed by a real Koha 26.05.02.002 in that notice and compared with the database, in every
situation the notice is tested in, with optional values filled and with them empty. A value that failed is not offered.
Copy the code as it is: the date, price and punctuation filters are part of it. Where a value can be empty, use the
"only if present" form. `USE` lines a value needs are listed at the end.

| Library address, second line | `[% branch.branchaddress2 %]` | `[% IF branch.branchaddress2 %][% branch.branchaddress2 %][% END %]` | message |
| Library address, third line | `[% branch.branchaddress3 %]` | `[% IF branch.branchaddress3 %][% branch.branchaddress3 %][% END %]` | message |
| Library city | `[% branch.branchcity %]` | `[% IF branch.branchcity %][% branch.branchcity %][% END %]` | message |
| Library state | `[% branch.branchstate %]` | `[% IF branch.branchstate %][% branch.branchstate %][% END %]` | message |
| Library postal code | `[% branch.branchzip %]` | `[% IF branch.branchzip %][% branch.branchzip %][% END %]` | message |
| Library country | `[% branch.branchcountry %]` | `[% IF branch.branchcountry %][% branch.branchcountry %][% END %]` | message |
| Library phone | `[% branch.branchphone %]` | `[% IF branch.branchphone %][% branch.branchphone %][% END %]` | message |
| Library fax | `[% branch.branchfax %]` | `[% IF branch.branchfax %][% branch.branchfax %][% END %]` | message |
| Library email | `[% branch.branchemail %]` | `[% IF branch.branchemail %][% branch.branchemail %][% END %]` | message |
| Library website | `[% branch.branchurl %]` | `[% IF branch.branchurl %][% branch.branchurl %][% END %]` | message |
| Address of the online catalogue | `[% Koha.Preference('OPACBaseURL') %]` | `[% IF Koha.Preference('OPACBaseURL') %][% Koha.Preference('OPACBaseURL') %][% END %]` | message |
| Address of the patron account | `[% Koha.Preference('OPACBaseURL') %]/cgi-bin/koha/opac-user.pl` | `[% IF Koha.Preference('OPACBaseURL') %][% Koha.Preference('OPACBaseURL') %]/cgi-bin/koha/opac-user.pl[% END %]` | message |
| Library name in the system preference LibraryName | `[% Koha.Preference('LibraryName') %]` | `[% IF Koha.Preference('LibraryName') %][% Koha.Preference('LibraryName') %][% END %]` | message |
| Today's date | `[% today \| $KohaDates %]` | always there | message |

## USE lines

Put these in the top block when you use such a value: `Koha` (links, LibraryName), `Price` (money), `ItemTypes` (item type),
`Branches` (home library of the item), `AuthorisedValues` (shelving location, collection), each as `USE Name;`.
